dct_description_sm: Provide Hourly and Daily weather data for the High Arctic Integrated Research and Monitoring Area. These data are essential in providing a context for the understanding of ongoing climate change. The synthesis includes the results from studies of modern conditions (climate, flora and fauna), quaternary geology and glacial history, paleoenvironmental records (i.e. ice cores, ocean, lakes, peat, archeological sites), permafrost dynamics and hydrologic systems.
dct_title_s: Hot Weather Creek Autostation Data from the High Arctic Integrated Research and Monitoring Area
